svg.title: When configuration replaces the saved value
svg.desc: For port: 3000 and HAI_APP_PORT=4000, only a successful check publishes 4000. Failed reads or validation retain the old value; reload subscribers receive the value or failure. Consumers must apply changed settings themselves.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: When configuration replaces the saved value
